sn22.24:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Tatra || voca || || Rūpam bhikkhave anabhijānam aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || Vedanam anabhijānam || pe || Saññam anabhijānam || Saṅkhāre anabhijānaṃ || Viññāṇam anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || || Rūpañca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ virājayaṃ pajaham bhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || Vedanam abhijānaṃ || Saññam || Saṅkhāre || || Viññāṇam abhijānam parijānaṃ virājayaṃ pajaham bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyāti || Sāvatthi || ||
